subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher follows as a core private API and web discovery surface in this feature stack, or pause this follow-up until the base API direction is settled?
rationale: The branch adds new persisted user preference data, public API routes, and visible discovery UI, so product/API direction and the private follow-state boundary need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Land the base API first
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear API, docs, security-boundary proof, and generated-artifact blockers, then rebase and review this UI slice.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Maintain the API, controls, and notification PRs as one coordinated feature stack while explicitly owning the private follow-state boundary and proof requirements.

options.title: Pause this follow-up
options.body: If the base follow graph direction is not accepted, pause or close this controls/discovery PR instead of carrying a conflicting stacked branch.

recommendation.title: Land the base API first
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear API, docs, security-boundary proof, and generated-artifact blockers, then rebase and review this UI slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal covers API routes, schema package artifacts, docs/OpenAPI, and the baseline creators route affected by this PR.
